parts.why: the page declares it is a post
a BlogPosting, with its author, for search and agents
the /blog/ index links every published post
the Atom feed has an entry for every published post
the page names its feed (a <link> with both attributes, in either order), so a reader finds it

the featured image: the BlogPosting's image, the page's og:image and a picture on the page are one image (site-kit#214); a site turns featured images off with "post_images": false in .sitekit/features.json
